question: Does one independently implemented archive-only verifier confirm the immutable attempt-4 receiver evidence after changing only the known negative-control contract lookup, without importing or executing the receiver?
level: finite archive verification of one already completed research-local receiver run; no native identity, transport or arithmetic authority
objects: The five immutable attempt-4 evidence files, their validation and inherited contracts, the retained predecessor outcomes, and one verifier source
types: Canonical JSON records, exact byte digests, ordered case names, checked/refused outcome tags and complete ordered renaming maps
quantifiers: Exactly twelve archived cases: two positive pairs and the ten inherited negative controls; no receiver rerun and no unrestricted renaming or coverage quantifier
arithmetic_domain: None. Additive zero and multiplicative unity remain separate and unevaluated; no quotient, zero-point, invertibility or arithmetic-truth judgment occurs.
candidate_grammar: Unchanged predecessor HistoryComposition(Hole,Use) profile and exact explicit identity correspondence; the verifier only reads serialized records
evaluation: Verify all pinned predecessor inputs, historical evidence coordinates, archive/stdout equality, declared counts and outcomes, exact positive mappings, raw forward/reverse order, refusal reasons, complete six-entry source/occurrence mutations and the 1 MiB evidence bound
allowed_source_delta: In verify_attempt4.py, load the unchanged inherited contract.json and obtain negative_controls from that record instead of validation-contract.json. No other verifier or evidence change is permitted before execution.
success: One verifier process writes ArchiveVerified with every check passing, zero search and zero new words; the receiver is not imported or executed and every attempt-4 input digest remains unchanged.
failure: Any exception, digest mismatch, order/reason mismatch, overwrite attempt or nonzero exit retains ArchiveUnknown; no correction replay or second verifier run is permitted.
protected: The receiver, all attempt-1 through attempt-4 evidence, every prior failure trace, validation contract and outcome, raw occurrence order, exact source/occurrence identities and complete maps; no 0090 coverage, 0092 promotion, M6 filler, native free, alpha-equivalence theorem or 0123 universality
